DIAGNOSIS READY: Antibiotic-Associated Diarrhea (Clostridioides difficile Colitis)

The clinical presentation of recent levofloxacin use, followed by severe watery diarrhea and abdominal cramping, is highly suggestive of *C. difficile* infection. While the specific toxin assay results are currently pending, the pre-test probability is extremely high given the antibiotic exposure and symptom profile. We will proceed with supportive care, including rehydration, and I will initiate empiric treatment with oral vancomycin pending final confirmation of the toxin results.
